models.modelSelectHelp: Select the model you want to use, for example gpt-4o or claude-3-5-sonnet.
models.modelLoadHelp: Select a credential, then load models from LiteLLM, or enter a model name.
models.nameHelp: A display name for this AI model inside CARE.
models.credentialHelp: Select the credential that you want to use to access the model.
models.descriptionHelp: Optional notes to help identify when this model should be used.
models.additionalParametersHelp: Optional parameters as JSON, such as temperature, top_p, or fallback_models.
models.freeModelHelp: Free or self-hosted models bypass all spending caps. When disabled, costs are tracked.
models.costLimitHelp: Global cap across all users on this model.
models.noModels: No models were returned for this credential.

credentials.name: Credential Name
credentials.nameHelp: A display name for your API credential.
credentials.keepKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep existing key
credentials.apiKeyHelp: Provide an API key and/or a base URL. At least one is required. Leave empty while editing to keep the existing key.
credentials.providerHelp: Select the LiteLLM provider for your API key, for example openai, groq, or openrouter.
credentials.baseUrlHelp: Custom endpoint for proxies, local providers, or hosted compatible APIs. Required if no API key is provided.
credentials.apiVersionHelp: Optional API version, commonly needed for Azure or OpenAI-compatible deployments.

hooks.title: AI Hooks
hooks.nameHelp: A short dashboard name that helps admins recognize where this AI hook is used.
hooks.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain when this hook should be used.
hooks.descriptionHelp: Optional. Add context about the feature, input data, or expected model behavior.
hooks.costLimitHelp: Optional. Total AI spend allowed for this hook across all studies. Leave empty for no cap.
hooks.noPromptTemplates: No prompt templates are available yet.
hooks.promptTemplateHelp: Only prompt templates with placeholders such as document text or study context are shown.
hooks.outputHelp: Text returns plain output. JSON expects structured data.
hooks.enabledHelp: Disabled hooks stay saved but should not be used by AI features.
hooks.noEnabledModels: No enabled AI models are available yet.
hooks.modelOrderHelp: Add models in the order CARE should try them. Priority 1 is the primary model. Priority 2 and later are fallback models.
hooks.reviewNote: Please confirm these settings before saving the AI hook.
hooks.modelOrderDescription: Add models in priority order. Priority 1 is tried first; later priorities are fallbacks.

budgets.title: AI Budget
budgets.costLimitHelp: Setting this to 0 blocks all usage at this level. To remove the cap entirely, close this modal and use the trash icon.

share.title: Share {resource}
share.expiryHelp: Required. Access expires on this date.
share.costLimitHelp: Optional. The same limit is applied to every selected {audience}.

confirm.deleteCredential: Delete credential "{name}"? Models linked to it will keep existing values, but cannot use this credential anymore.
confirm.resetBudget: Reset the spending counter for this cap? Past usage will no longer count toward the limit.
confirm.removeCap: Remove this budget? AI usage at this level will no longer be capped.

errors.credentialRequired: Provide an API key or a base URL
errors.saveHookModels: Failed to save AI hook models
errors.selectRole: Please select at least one role
errors.selectUser: Please select at least one user
errors.requestTimeout: The AI request timed out after {timeoutMs}ms (command: {command}).
errors.noResponse: No response received from the AI service.
